title: MarkSpec tool configuration
description: Schema for a project's .markspec.yaml profile binding and tool configuration.

profiles.description: Profile specifiers the project activates, in order.

default-profile.description: Set false to opt out of the bundled default profile.

exclude.description: Gitignore-syntax patterns excluded from project file discovery, anchored at the project root. Null or an empty YAML key uses the default empty list.

caption-conventions.description: Per-keyword caption placement: where the caption sits relative to its block. Null or an empty YAML key uses the default empty mapping.
